purpose: Teach: 三国志/ハンマー/バイキング/スターウォーズ/カーニバル/肺炎/領事館/赤ワイン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、三国志の本を読んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer was telling me about the Three Kingdoms—you know, that historical book. Such an interesting conversation.
lines.style: Warm, almost musing tone. Speaking as if sharing something she noticed and found quietly charming. Gentle pace, like she's turning the memory over in her mind.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店の補修にハンマー用意しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should grab a hammer and get those repairs done in the shop when we have a moment.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but not rushed. Light, practical energy. The tone of someone who's noticed something that needs fixing and is already thinking through the when and how.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、北欧バイキング料理のお話されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and earlier a customer was telling me all about Nordic Viking cuisine—it sounded fascinating.
lines.style: Bright, engaged delivery. Leans into the enthusiasm without overdoing it. Quick pace on the descriptive words. The genuine interest of someone who loves hearing what people care about.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、スターウォーズの新作を観てきたんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer mentioned they just saw the new Star Wars film. I think they're really excited about it.
lines.style: Light, bright observation. Quick and conversational, like she's passing along a nice piece of gossip. Warm without needing to perform enthusiasm—just noticing and sharing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、地域のカーニバル、お店も参加しましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, we should think about having the shop participate in the local carnival this year.
lines.style: Thoughtful pitch delivered with quiet conviction. Slightly slower pace on the main idea. Genuine—not pushing, but genuinely believing this would be good.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、肺炎で長期入院されてたんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer told me they were in the hospital for a long time with pneumonia. Only just getting back out now.
lines.style: Softer, more careful tone. Speaks with the weight of understanding something difficult. Slow pace. The kindness of someone who's really taken in what they've heard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、領事館でビザの手続きされてたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: One of the regulars was handling visa paperwork at the consulate. Sounded like quite the process.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly wondering. Even pace, like she's still processing the complexity of what they described. Gentle respect in the delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、赤ワイン煮込みを加えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: I've been thinking—we should add a red wine stew to the new menu. It would be perfect for fall.
lines.style: Animated but grounded. Builds slightly on 'red wine stew'—that's where the idea really lives. Quick energy, like she's excited but practical about it.
